projectName: StaffTime — Workforce OS for Shopify POS
notes: MVP core built and deployed (stafftime-3) to spaceraceplayground.myshopify.com.
Dev config split: shopify.app.toml (deploy/webhooks) + shopify.app.local.toml (localhost dev without webhooks).
Fixed: POS timer server sync, dashboard auto-refresh every 10s, open entry query, shop domain normalization.
Fixed: unique PIN enforcement — duplicate PINs blocked in Admin and rejected on POS.
POS tile must be manually added to Smart Grid in Settings → Point of sale.
ST028 complete: POS workflow integration tests (6), Android QA checklist, dev:pos script for ngrok.
ST032 complete: Employees add form expanded to match competitor staff profile flow with payroll, availability, and payment method fields.
Fixed: payment method detail fields now render conditionally based on selected method.
Fixed: employee form fields wrap cleanly; payroll type is hourly, weekly, or monthly with one matching amount field.
Next priorities: employee edit/PIN change, missed punch create form, production hosting, App Store prep.
Competitive reference: Zon Staff Management on Shopify App Store.
